subject: duplicate-registration
detail: A overwrites an existing account when the same email registers again; with one account per person this would let anyone take over an account (including one created or linked by OAuth)
solutions: Refuse registration when the normalised email already belongs to a user
recommended: Refuse a duplicate registration with AuthError; never overwrite

subject: role-change-rules
detail: C's set_role trusts a role string from the caller and accepts any new role name; the user requires that only an admin changes roles and nobody raises their own role
solutions: Resolve the caller from the session; admin only; validate the role; refuse raising one's own role
recommended: Caller from session token; PermissionError unless admin; unknown role rejected; self-raise refused

subject: first-admin
detail: Only an admin can grant admin, and no source creates the first admin
solutions: A setup-only bootstrap_admin that works only while no admin exists
recommended: bootstrap_admin(email, password) for setup; refused once an admin exists
